text:
For a typical heated blanket, I’d look at the **[BLUETTI Elite 100 V2](https://www.blackoutwise.com/best/best-power-station-for-electric-blanket)**. Its **1,024Wh** battery is estimated to run a 150W blanket for about 12 hours when the blanket’s thermostat cycles on and off—enough for a night, with some margin.

Check the blanket’s label or manual before buying: runtime depends on its **average** draw, not just its rated watts. If yours draws close to 260W continuously, a 1kWh station won’t last all night; one estimate puts an 8-hour run at about **2,600Wh** of rated battery capacity ([runtime and sizing guide](https://homepowerfacts.com/can-it-run/electric-blanket/)). Keep the power station off the bed and plug the blanket directly into its outlet.
